title: Among white moon faces teeenagers understand one thing Anger overspills in Consciousness of creativity that only comes with practice in Home and space
summary: Among white moon faces teeenagers understand one thing Anger overspills in Consciousness of creativity that only comes with practice in Home and space humans grounded and remember practice, practice, practice #smallpoems #foolingwithwords Found poem from Shirley Geok-Lin Lim
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Among white moon
faces teeenagers
understand
one thing
Anger overspills
in
Consciousness of
creativity that only
comes with practice
in Home and space
humans grounded
and remember
practice, practice, practice
#smallpoems
#foolingwithwords
Found poem from Shirley Geok-Lin Lim
